paper_id: The Ergodicity of the Collatz Process in Positive Integer Field
title: The Ergodicity of the Collatz Process in Positive Integer Field
motivation: Collatz conjecture is an unsolved problem since 1930s with 'random' iteration despite deterministic function
problem_framing: Generalize Collatz function into non-deterministic processes, map to graphs, prove reachability via structural analysis
key_insight: Introduce models M2→M1→MS→M0: prove properties in relaxed models then transfer to original via edge removal
method_signature: Cluster decomposition (9/5/3-cluster) and succession theorems TDDFFBBT, DFFBTT in ternary representation
evaluation_criteria: All positive integers reach 1 (Ω₀=ℕ⁺), unique cycle 4→2→1→4
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Admit 'there exist simpler proofs' but choose complex method 'to illustrate the structure of the Collatz graphs'
evidence_for_taste: very hard to solve because the iteration process is very 'random'
to illustrate the structure of the Collatz graphs
there exist simpler proofs on Ω₁=ℕ⁺
thinking_moves: 从确定性过程放松约束到非确定性,建立层次化模型链(M2→M1→MS→M0)
在放松模型中证明可达性,再通过删边操作把性质迁移回原模型
用图论聚类(9-cluster/5-cluster/3-cluster)分解正整数空间,逐块证明连通性
识别核心动作序列('TDDFFBBT', 'DFFBTT')作为结构生成的 succession 函数
承认为了阐明结构而选择更复杂的证明路径
